assets.mobileSimplification: Disable pointer coordinate tracking; apply subtle linear-gradient shimmer on page load.

assets.triggerConcept: Orbital progression of planetary knowledge spheres around central prism inspired by celestial framing. Benchmark accessible SVG/CSS before Canvas.
assets.mobileSimplification: Horizontal scroll snap between knowledge domain cards.

assets.triggerConcept: Hover or focus on verdict highlights annotation trail from fountain pen to final verification mark. Implement via accessible DOM events.
assets.mobileSimplification: Tap to toggle between AI extract and Human annotation.
